```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup, echo=TRUE,include=T, tidy=TRUE}
library(QuickBLAST)
QuickBLAST::isQuickBLASTLoaded()
blastp_inst <- QuickBLAST::CreateQuickBLASTInstance(seq_type = 1, strand = 0, program = "blastp")
blastn_inst <- QuickBLAST::CreateQuickBLASTInstance(seq_type = 0, strand = 0, program = "blastn")
tblastx_inst <- QuickBLAST::CreateQuickBLASTInstance(seq_type = 0, strand = 0, program = "tblastx")
blastp_inst
blastn_inst
tblastx_inst
```

```{r inst_man, echo=TRUE,include=T, tidy=TRUE}
QuickBLAST::GetInstanceCount()
QuickBLAST::GetInstanceID(blastp_inst)
QuickBLAST::GetInstanceID(blastn_inst)
QuickBLAST::GetInstanceID(tblastx_inst)
QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(0)
QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(1)
QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(2)
identical(QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(0), blastp_inst)
identical(QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(1), blastn_inst)
identical(QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(2), tblastx_inst)
identical(QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(0), tblastx_inst)
QuickBLAST::DeleteQuickBLASTInstance(ptr_id = 1)
QuickBLAST::GetInstanceCount()
QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(1)
identical(QuickBLAST::GetQuickBLASTInstance(1), blastn_inst)
blastn_inst <- QuickBLAST::CreateQuickBLASTInstance(seq_type = 0, strand = 0, program = "blastn")
```


```{r test}
QuickBLAST::BLAST2Seqs(tblastx_inst, "AAAAAAAAAAAATTTTTTTTTTTTGGGGGGGGGGGCCCCCCCCC", "TTTTTTTTTTTGGGGGGGGGGGG")
QuickBLAST::BLAST2Seqs(blastn_inst, "AAAAAAAAAAAATTTTTTTTTTTTGGGGGGGGGGGCCCCCCCCC", "TTTTTTTTTTTGGGGGGGGGGGG")
```
